text:
Hanko, 127 km by road from Helsinki, is hardest hit: 16 nights away with 15 breast sessions versus 6 with 5 [S60, S59].

1. The radiotherapy lead could evaluate a single 8 Gy session as default for uncomplicated painful bone metastases, with equal pain relief but more retreatment [S31, S30, S62]. In Hanko, expected nights away are 6.2 with the multi-fraction course versus 2.4 with a single 8 Gy session [S60, S59]. Within 30 days, the clinical team reviews eligible cases [S31]. It serves "National targets and key effectiveness indicators defined for agreed cancers" [S61].

2. The breast radiotherapy lead could evaluate 5 sessions as default for eligible patients (whole breast or chest wall, no nodal radiotherapy), non-inferior to 15 sessions, with distance a reason [S9, S11, S15]. For breast, the county would remove 33 nights away and free 1,505 machine sessions yearly [S33, S57, S34, S35, S60]. Within 30 days, the clinical team reviews eligibility criteria [S15]. It serves "Patients receive treatment within target times" [S25, S24].

3. The quality lead could publish schedule mix and radiotherapy use by distance band yearly [S26]. Within 30 days, the quality lead and the clinical team decide which figures to report [S26]. It serves "Regional differences in treatment are available and used to steer services (cross-cutting indicator)" [S26].

Distances are road km from centre points, and the current schedule mix is unknown [S59, S60, S16].
